lina: flagging an odd A/B where rwd-v6-int4 shows better latency but slightly worse fidelity on short-answer slice 'kb-faqs'. A/B window 60m, traffic 10/90.
omar: numbers?
lina: short-faq slice: accuracy metric delta -0.7% absolute, tokens saved per resp -6%, p50 -18%. sample_count short-faq=12k.
tess: For short slices I'd be comfortable auto-promoting if fidelity delta <1% and latency gain >10% for >24h. But need to decide thresholds and stable-window duration.
omar: propose: for non-critical slices, require 24h of consistent positive latency but allow small fidelity loss <=1% as tradeoff. For critical slices require fidelity >= baseline.
lina: note: we currently have policy inconsistency between 'canary' and 'ab' flows. Gatebook should unify definitions: what is "critical" vs "non-critical" and per-slice tolerances.
infra-bot: deploylog: A/B experiment lina-627222 started.
omar: i'll draft a short PR to normalize the policy names and add two profiles: conservative and perf-first.
tess: Also ensure AB comparisons weight by user-impact (e.g., revenue or legal).
lina: good call. Will add sample weight tags in the metrics pipeline.
